scientific_objective: Increase machine-first structural evidence coverage and autonomous refinement while preserving fail-closed semantics and preventing retrospective improvement claims on Unit003.

allowed_learning_signals: path-only acquisition precision after exact anchor hits was poor under the frozen no-threshold top-24 policy
the frozen E0 Python-only extractor did not extract Go structural candidates
generated refinement requests had no machine-ingestion loop
E0 correctly failed closed with unresolved material obligations
forbidden_adaptation: no Unit003 target source bytes may be copied into E1 implementation tests or fixtures
no kubectl-specific repository, command, path, identifier, package, function, or symbol special case
no Unit003 selected-path allowlist or ranking bonus
no resource-version-specific rule beyond the pre-existing general version-token family already present in E0
no E1 score, tuning, threshold, or promotion decision may use Unit003 as validation
no E0 scientific artifact may be rewritten to incorporate E1 behavior
Unit003 may never be rescored as the first E1 prospective validation unit

A1_adaptive_evidence_acquisition.goal: Replace fixed lexical filler with bounded deterministic machine-only evidence expansion.
A1_adaptive_evidence_acquisition.round0: tree-metadata-only anchor enrollment from screened operation tokens and surface arguments
A1_adaptive_evidence_acquisition.round1_and_round2: content-informed but machine-only expansion from explicit import/include/call/reference tokens extracted from already enrolled files; candidate paths are resolved only against the frozen repository tree
A1_adaptive_evidence_acquisition.determinism: all candidate scores and tie breaks must be canonical and lexical; the same tree, operation, and enrolled bytes must reproduce the same evidence set
A1_adaptive_evidence_acquisition.network_scope: exact pinned target repository and revision only

A2_typed_language_aware_structural_extra.python: AST-based extraction retained and extended with assignment/dataflow/call/branch spans
A2_typed_language_aware_structural_extra.go: Go-standard-library AST extraction; no regex-only authority upgrade
A2_typed_language_aware_structural_extra.generic_fallback: token/name hints may request refinement but may never establish a material role

A3_material_role_proof_assembler.structurally_supported_rule: a role may be STRUCTURALLY_SUPPORTED only from typed facts connected by explicit evidence-backed dataflow/call/branch relations; name similarity alone is insufficient
A3_material_role_proof_assembler.reason: E1 is a machine prediction layer evaluated prospectively against later independent adjudication; it does not self-certify scientific truth

A4_closed_loop_refinement.goal: Turn unresolved obligations into deterministic machine actions when the action can be satisfied from the same frozen repository without human semantic translation.
allowed_actions: acquire additional exact-revision files selected from AST-derived dependency/reference evidence
re-run language extractors on newly acquired bytes
rebuild typed fact graph and material-role support
emit unresolved probes for obligations that remain unsatisfied
forbidden_actions: human answer injection before the prediction seal
web search during an exam run
A4_closed_loop_refinement.termination: fixed point, maximum expansion rounds, or maximum total files, whichever occurs first

A5_prediction_layer.preservation_rule: all material roles structurally supported and no contradictory flow/witness candidate remains; machine prediction only, not canonical scientific authority
A5_prediction_layer.regression_rule: requires a positive contradictory structural witness showing a consequence-defining surface input or coordinate is disconnected, overwritten, bypassed, or mapped to an unconditional effect path; mere absence of evidence can never produce regression
A5_prediction_layer.incomplete_rule: any unresolved material obligation, conflicting structural interpretation, extractor failure on material evidence, or refinement termination before proof closure

allowed_inputs: pre-Unit003 repository-generic synthetic/calibration patterns whose expected structural truth was fixed independently of Unit003
forbidden_inputs: Unit004 or later target source bytes before E1 freeze
required_positive_families: surface argument flows to version/precondition coordinate, guarded effect, mismatch branch
equivalent multi-hop assignment and helper-call flow
required_negative_and_adversarial_famili: version-like names with no material flow
argument parsed then overwritten before mutation
unconditional mutation with decorative version token
parse failure on a material file

freeze_sequence: commit this protocol before E1 implementation
implement E1 only against allowed synthetic inputs
run adversarial qualification and repair implementation defects only against allowed synthetic inputs
freeze exact E1 component byte identities and evaluation contract
only after E1 freeze create and execute Unit004 target-selection protocol
seal Unit004 machine prediction before any human gold or target-specific repair
adjudicate Unit004 independently after the machine seal
never retroactively retune E1 on Unit004 and report it as prospective performance

claim_boundary.e1_freeze_will_establish: a prospectively frozen machine prediction system with deterministic acquisition/extraction/refinement mechanics and explicit abstention rules
